title: Geist health spike: Bullet + Spirit Lifesteal vs Spirit Resilience at 12.8k
question: Which 3.2k of health items gives Geist more survival at 12.8k against a gun lane and a spirit lane?
hypothesis: Calc (G3 vs G0): lifesteal path +180 HP, +6 spirit, 13% bullet/spirit lifesteal; Spirit Resilience path 30% spirit resist (spirit-effective HP 3954 vs 2948). Prediction: lifesteal wins vs gun opponent by >=10%, Spirit Resilience wins vs spirit opponent by >=10%.
procedure: record HP left and damage dealt

decision.rule: Replace Spirit Resilience as the health spike only if G3 wins vs BOTH opponents; if split, keep G0 and note lifesteal as a gun-lane reorder.
